en: Niyyānikaduka (The Pair on the State of Leading Out)
Dependent on a state that is not leading to liberation (*naniyyānika*), a state that is not leading to liberation arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … one.
Dependent on a state that is not leading to liberation, a state that is not leading to liberation arises by way of the root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is both not leading to liberation and not leading to liberation, a state that is not leading to liberation arises by way of the root condition … one. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
